description: kenmcneill/Cortex — An experimental compact system for doing game-based EEG biofeedback using an OpenBCI data stream over UDP. A control component receives and processes EEG data and calculates a reward value based on configurable thresholds. A feedback component provides real-time audiovisual feedback and scoring to the neurofeedback user wearing the BCI headgear.
